name: Mira
source:
Queen consort, second in rank, and current vice-captain.

Although she has a secret, she respects and wants to support Silvia. She is the youngest vice-captain.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
